rows.fix_directive: Add 2-3 easier warm-up questions testing basic colour-coding identification and absolute reference conversion ($B$10 format), then ramp through named range creation, before the IF(AND()) checks; aim for 8-10 total questions spanning SUM→conditional→lookup→multi-step to hit 50-100 points.
